content.short: Yield Guild Games is a crypto gaming community that collectively invests in games and NFTs.
content.description: Yield Guild Games is a fully community owned and operated collective of like-minded crypto gaming and NFT investors. Within the Yield Guild Games DAO, members can rent a wide variety of NFTs used in popular blockchain-based games such as Axie Infinity, Sandbox, and Splinterlands, enabling participation without owning assets upfront. The project aims to give crypto gamers greater investment exposure to the industry while lowering the barrier to entry for enthusiasts, fostering broader participation in blockchain gaming ecosystems.
content.meta: Yield Guild Games is a community-owned DAO of crypto gaming and NFT investors. Discover Yield Guild Games and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
